title: Lay bridge plate across trench and push block to far platform
instruction: Lay the bridge plate across the trench, then push the block over it onto the far platform without letting the plate or the block fall into the trench.
setup: Two grey platforms (120 mm along y, 260 mm along x, 30 mm tall) separated by a 90 mm trench along x at y = 0. Free orange bridge plate (80 x 130 x 6 mm, 0.05 kg, friction 1.5) resting on the near platform at (0.30, +0.20, TOP + 0.033). Free blue block (40 x 40 x 30 mm, 0.05 kg, friction 0.5) on the near platform at (0.25, +0.14, TOP + 0.045). White target mark (70 x 70 x 2 mm) on the far platform at (0.30, -0.14, TOP + 0.031).
context: Bridging open gaps between conveyors and transfer platforms is essential in manufacturing and automated material transfer to prevent payloads and tools from tumbling into open machine trenches.
scoring: Ladder: 0.25 for bridge plate seated across trench (both y-edges overlap platform lips by >= 20 mm, tilt < 3 deg, resting); 0.50 for block on the bridge (XY center within bridge footprint); 0.75 for block on the far platform past trench lip (y <= -0.045); 1.00 for block centered on target mark within 15 mm and still, bridge still seated, arms clear (> 60 mm), held stable for 2.0 s (40 steps). Zero-gate: plate or block falling into trench (z < TOP + 0.030 - 0.020 m) latches fell = score 0.0 permanently.
fidelity: Rigid body PhysX dynamics with realistic friction (1.5 for bridge, 0.5 for sliding block), contact compliance, exact trench geometry, and bimanual arm reach envelopes without simulated sensory shortcuts.
reset_notes: Bridge plate and block reset to initial resting positions on near platform, grippers open at home stance.
